subject: Information Theory
title: Free Press as Information Channel
description: A 60-second lesson on Free Press as Information Channel.

hook.text: Countries with a free press consistently rank higher on corruption indexes. Transparency is a disinfectant.

buildup.text: The press channels information between government actions and citizen awareness. Suppress it and corruption thrives.

discovery.text: Shannon's model applies: the government is the source, the press is the channel, and citizens are the receivers.

twist.text: A captured press is worse than none. It creates false information, driving mutual information below zero in trust.

climax.text: Press freedom is information channel capacity for democracy. Reduce it and the entire system degrades.

punchline.text: Free press: high capacity. Censored press: noise only.

quiz.question: How does a free press function in information-theoretic terms?
options: As an information channel between government actions and citizens
